goal: Prevent exposing Windows codesigning private key passphrases to other processes on signing hosts
Protects release keys from appearing in process listings during detached signature creation
agreement: Neutral concept stance with an unanswered question about shell builtin portability (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because passing codesigning passphrases as process arguments exposes private keys to host process tables
Safeguards sensitive signing credentials used by maintainers during Windows release packaging
